mapper.select: SELECT ro.id AS deliveryRouteOrderId, ro.order_id AS salesOrderId, ro.signed_at AS signedAt, ro.signed_by AS signedBy, o.customer_id AS customerId, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customerNameSnapshot FROM delivery_route_order ro JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = ro.order_id WHERE ro.id = #{deliveryRouteOrderId} AND ro.deleted = FALSE AND ro.fulfillment_status = 'SIGNED'

SELECT ob.id AS inventoryOutboundItemId, ob.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.product_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ob.quantity AS quantity, oi.locked_unit_price AS unitPrice FROM inventory_outbound_item ob JOIN sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = ob.sales_order_item_id WHERE ob.deleted = FALSE AND ob.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND ob.sales_order_item_id IS NOT NULL AND ob.quantity > 0 ORDER BY ob.id

SELECT rt.id AS orderReturnId, rt.return_no AS returnNo, rt.order_id AS orderId, rt.approved_at AS approvedAt, rt.updated_by AS approvedBy, rt.reason AS reason FROM order_return rt WHERE rt.id = #{orderReturnId} AND rt.deleted = FALSE AND rt.status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT rt.id FROM order_return rt WHERE rt.order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND rt.deleted = FALSE AND rt.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY rt.id

SELECT ri.id AS orderReturnItemId, ri.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.product_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ri.approved_quantity AS approvedQuantity, ri.locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, ri.approved_amount AS approvedAmount FROM order_return_item ri JOIN sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.order_item_id WHERE ri.return_id = #{orderReturnId} AND ri.deleted = FALSE AND ri.approved_quantity > 0 AND ri.approved_amount > 0 ORDER BY ri.id
